name: Pi-hahiroth
line: Pi-hahiroth was a camping spot by the sea in Egypt, where God led the Israelites just before He rescued them from Pharaoh's army.

moments.title: Camp by the sea
moments.text: The LORD told Moses to turn the Israelites back and camp at Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea. He said He would harden Pharaoh's heart so Pharaoh would chase them, and the Egyptians would know that He is the LORD.

moments.title: Pharaoh catches up
moments.text: Pharaoh changed his mind and chased Israel with his chariots and army, and he overtook them camped by the sea near Pi-hahiroth. The Israelites were terrified and cried out to the LORD.

moments.title: A stop on the journey
moments.text: Israel's travel list says they left Etham, turned back to Pi-hahiroth, and camped near Migdol. From there they set out and crossed through the sea.
